dct_title_s: Cimbebas et Caffariæ Littora a Catenbela ad Promontorium Bonæ Spei. Paſcaerte van Cimbebas en Caffares Streckende van Catembela tot Cabo de Bona Esperanca
dct_description_sm: Similar to Ottens map (see NOR 0255). Surrounding the cartouche is a group of lions, a leopard, goat and a snake. Lower corner, a group led by Neptune. Battling ships and two compass roses with rhumb lines decorate the Atlantic.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0254, p. 291
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0254.
